crownPassive.name: Her mother's doll
crownPassive.text: The first of your heroes to die each fight survives on 2 health instead, and one of your dead front-rank cards returns to its slot on 1 health, if there is one.

bond.text: While another Rus' hero of yours lives, her heals restore +1.
bond.name: Kin of Rus'

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

actions.name: The doll's advice
actions.text: Heal 3 to one of your heroes, who also gets +1 Guard this round.
